_comment: landscape-completeness-score (board SkDatakwaliteit). The rules OpenRegister scores a usage by on every save, and the body fields it writes the score to. The Data quality page (GET /api/data-quality) reads these same rules to count, per rule, how many of an organisation's usages meet them. The module schema already declared its rules; it gets the body fields so its score can be listed too.
